name: Birla Precision Technologies Ltd
moat_evidence: India market-share holder: ITM 'Dagger Brand' products 'have the leading market share in India for Drills' — Birla Precision Technologies, Indian Tool Manufacturers division page (birlaprecision.com/itm-main.php)

India's leading manufacturer: 'Pioneer and Leader in HSS Cutting Tools in India since 1937' and 'the First Cutting Tool Company in India' to conform to worldwide benchmarks — Birla Precision Technologies company pages

Working in a niche segment: tool holder division is a Kennametal-Birla joint venture making AT3 tool holders, collets and work holding, supported by 350+ dealers and 11 stocking branches — Birla Precision Technologies About page
research_note: Birla Precision Technologies Ltd (BIRLAPREC, BSE 522105) is classed by Trendlyne under General Industrials / Industrial Machinery, matching the 'precision engineering' hint; Screener puts market cap at about Rs 328 crore with ROCE 9.4% and ROE 6.5%. Its Indian Tool Manufacturers division has made HSS cutting tools under the Dagger brand since 1937 and states it holds the leading India market share in drills, and the tool-holder line runs as a Kennametal joint venture — both leadership and niche claims with a source behind them. Flagged unclear rather than promising because the claims are the company's own words with no percentage attached, and single-digit ROCE argues that whatever position exists is not currently earning excess returns; the Yash Birla group ownership is a further thing for a person to weigh.

name: Cords Cable Industries Ltd
moat_evidence: Working in a niche segment: specialised, custom-designed cable portfolio including fieldbus, fire-survival, EPR, low-temperature, low-smoke-zero-halogen, oil-and-gas, water-desalination and hybrid cables rather than commodity power cable — Cords Cable Industries product disclosures / Wire & Cable India profile

Working in a niche segment: 'established position in the control, instrumentation and power cables market and established relationships with reputed customers', with ~23% revenue CAGR over the three fiscals to FY25 — CARE Ratings press release on Cords Cable Industries Limited, 14 October 2025
research_note: Cords Cable Industries Ltd (CORDSCABLE, BSE 532941) is classed by Trendlyne under Consumer Durables / Wires & Cables, roughly matching the 'industrial & capital goods' hint. Unlike the volume players it concentrates on instrumentation, control and thermocouple-extension cables plus specials such as fire-survival, LSZH and desalination cable, which are specified into a project rather than bought on price. CARE Ratings' October 2025 review credits it with an established position in that segment and long-standing customer relationships, which is the closest thing to a sourced niche claim available. Flagged unclear because no market-share figure or ranking exists in any source I could reach, and the numeric channels on both Screener and Trendlyne were unavailable this pass.

name: Medicamen Biotech Ltd-$
moat_evidence: India's leading manufacturer: 'In India, MBL is among the leading companies in oncology segment with its own sales force and a branding team' — Medicamen Biotech company disclosures, via India Infoline company summary

Working in a niche segment: 'lean operations and specialized focus on Oncology formulations give it a niche advantage', with a dedicated oncology finished-dosage facility (Haridwar Unit II) now commissioned — Medicamen Biotech FY2023-24 annual report and company disclosures
research_note: Medicamen Biotech Ltd (MEDICAMEQ, BSE 531146) is classed by Trendlyne under Pharmaceuticals & Biotechnology / Pharmaceuticals, matching the 'pharma & healthcare' hint. It makes generic finished dosage forms with a deliberate concentration in oncology formulations, running three plants (two at Haridwar, one at Bhiwadi) including a dedicated oncology unit. Oncology FDF is a genuinely restricted niche — containment, handling and regulatory requirements keep the number of Indian makers small — and the company states in its own materials that it is among India's leading players in the segment. Flagged unclear because 'among the leading' carries no number or ranking, and because the oncology unit is recent enough that the position is a plan as much as an established fact.

name: Andhra Petrochemicals Ltd
moat_evidence: Only Indian company: sole producer of oxo-alcohols (2-ethyl hexanol, n-butanol, isobutanol) in India — Trendlyne company profile for ANDHRAPET (trendlyne.com/equity/about/2024/ANDHRAPET/)

Import substitute: the company supplies roughly 35-40% of Indian oxo-alcohol demand with imports covering the rest, so every ton of added capacity displaces an import — Trendlyne company profile, ANDHRAPET

Import substitute / tariff wall: oxo-alcohol imports into India have been the subject of anti-dumping investigations in which the Oxo Alcohols Industries Association named Andhra Petrochemicals Ltd, Hyderabad as the domestic producer — DGTR / Department of Commerce anti-dumping findings on acyclic alcohols
India market-share holder: about 35-40% of domestic oxo-alcohol consumption served by the single domestic producer — Trendlyne company profile, ANDHRAPET
research_note: Andhra Petrochemicals Ltd (ANDHRAPET, BSE 500012) is classed by Trendlyne under Chemicals & Petrochemicals / Petrochemicals, matching the scan's 'chemicals' hint. It makes oxo-alcohols — 2-ethyl hexanol, n-butanol and isobutanol — at Visakhapatnam, feeding plasticisers, acrylates, solvents and inks. It is the only producer of these alcohols in India and covers roughly 35-40% of domestic demand, the balance being imported, which is a clean hit on both the import-substitute and sole-Indian-maker criteria; the segment has also carried anti-dumping duty protection. Screener's MCP server returned no ratios or market cap for this symbol (only the shareholding table, showing promoters steady at 45.04%), so the cyclicality and margin quality of the business still need a person's look.

name: Innovassynth Technologies (India) Ltd
moat_evidence: Only Indian company / India's leading manufacturer: "Innovassynth is the pioneer in offering commercial-scale Nucleosides from India, globally." — innovassynth.com home page, repeated on its offerings page as "We are the pioneers in offering commercial-scale Nucleosides from India."

Working in a niche segment: commercial supply of protected nucleosides, phosphoramidites, reagents (DMT-Cl), GalNAc delivery platforms and ADC linkers for DNA/RNA therapeutics, with "proven credentials in oligonucleotide drugs from preclinical to clinical phase" — innovassynth.com/offerings-innovations/
Working in a niche segment: specialty chemicals vertical covering organometallics, polymer additives, ALD/CVD precursors and semiconductor chemicals — innovassynth.com
research_note: Innovassynth Technologies (India) Ltd (INOVSYNTH, BSE 533315) is the clearest find of this pass, and both automated sector guesses were wrong: the scan's regex read 'Technologies' as IT services, and Trendlyne files it under Others / Investment Companies. Screener describes the real business — a contract research, development and manufacturing organisation in pharmaceutical intermediates, oligonucleotide building blocks and specialty chemicals — with market cap about Rs 1,312 crore on TTM sales of Rs 146 crore, from a plant at Khopoli. Its own site claims to be the pioneer in commercial-scale nucleosides from India, and the product list (protected nucleosides, phosphoramidites, DMT-Cl, GalNAc delivery platforms, ADC linkers, plus ALD/CVD semiconductor precursors) is a genuinely specialised field with very few Indian makers. Flagged promising: the claim is specific, on the company's own record, and matches the only-Indian-company and niche criteria. A person should still verify how much revenue the oligonucleotide vertical actually carries — Trendlyne's document and overview channels were rate-limited all pass, so no filing text or segment split was reachable.

name: Hindusthan Insulators & Industries Ltd
moat_evidence: India's leading manufacturer: "leading manufacturer of overhead conductors and electro porcelain high tension insulators" — Hindusthan Group Power Conductors & Insulators division page (hindusthan.co.in/businessdivision.aspx?mpgid=10)

India's leading manufacturer: "First company in India to manufacture 500KV conductor", with BIS certification for AAC, ACSR, AAAC and AACSR up to 800 KV lines and current supply of conductors for 800 KV lines — same page

Working in a niche segment: electro-porcelain high-tension insulators including disc, line post and railway traction types, more than 100,000 MT capacity, exports to over 33 countries with the first conductor exported in 1961, type-tested at CPRI, ERDA, CESI Italy, EDF France and Hydro Quebec — same page
research_note: Hindusthan Insulators & Industries Ltd (HUIL/HIIL, BSE 539984) was renamed from Hindusthan Urban Infrastructure in February 2026; Screener describes it as manufacturing electro-porcelain high tension insulators and part of 'The Hindusthan Group', with market cap about Rs 1,002 crore on TTM sales of Rs 390 crore — well above the exchange feed's small-cap guess. Electro-porcelain HT insulators are a genuinely short-listed product in India, and the group's own division page claims leading-manufacturer status plus a first-in-India 500 KV conductor and BIS certification to 800 KV. Ambiguity worth recording rather than guessing past: those claims sit on the Hindusthan Group site covering a combined 'Power Conductors & Insulators' division, and this pass could not establish whether the conductor business sits inside the listed entity or a sibling group company — Screener's description of the listed company mentions only insulators. Flagged unclear for that reason, and because 'leading manufacturer' is company marketing copy with no share percentage attached.

name: PPAP Automotive Ltd
moat_evidence: Working in a niche segment: automotive body sealing systems and injection-moulded interior/exterior parts made through PPAP Tokai India Rubber, a JV with Tokai Kogyo of Japan, account for 94.3% of revenue — PPAP Automotive FY2025 annual report / company profile

Working in a niche segment: supplies Maruti Suzuki, Honda, Toyota and other OEMs on model-life tooling programmes from five plants (Noida, Surajpur, Chennai, Pathredi, Viramgam) — PPAP Automotive FY2024-25 annual report
research_note: PPAP Automotive Ltd (PPAP, BSE 532934) is classed by Trendlyne under Automobiles & Auto Components / Auto Parts & Equipment, matching the 'auto & mobility' hint. Its business is automotive body sealing systems — extruded weatherstrips and injection-moulded trims — supplied to Maruti, Honda and Toyota under a long-running technical tie-up with Tokai Kogyo, and it is described in company materials as a top Indian manufacturer in that segment. Sealing systems are a specialised, tooling-gated product locked to a vehicle model's life, which is a real fit for the niche criterion. Flagged unclear rather than promising because no source states an India market-share percentage or ranking — the 'top manufacturer' language is company marketing copy, and neither Screener nor Trendlyne could supply a figure this pass.

name: DCM Shriram Industries Ltd-$
moat_evidence: Working in a niche segment / only Indian company: Shriram Rayons at Kota is 'amongst the world's major manufacturers of high tenacity rayon tyre cord', the sole such plant in India, established 1965 with know-how from Beaunit Fibers Inc., USA — DCM Shriram Industries divisional page (dcmsr.com/rayons-nylon) and The Textile Magazine profile of Shriram Rayons
India's leading manufacturer: company leadership states it is the top supplier to at least two of the six largest tyre companies in the world — The Textile Magazine, Shriram Rayons profile
research_note: DCM Shriram Industries Ltd (DCMSRIND, BSE 523369) is classed by Trendlyne under Food, Beverages & Tobacco / Sugar, not the 'industrial & capital goods' the name-based hint assumed — but it is genuinely a diversified manufacturer of sugar, alcohol, fine chemicals and industrial fibres, so the mismatch is a mis-labelling rather than grounds to rule it out. The moat evidence sits in one division: Shriram Rayons at Kota makes high tenacity rayon tyre cord yarn and fabric, is the only such plant in India, and is described as being among the world's major producers and the top supplier to two of the six biggest global tyre makers. Set as promising because rayon tyre cord is a genuinely rare, technically-gated product with a shrinking global supplier list; flagged for a person because sugar dominates group revenue and the rayon plant's economics are not visible in Screener or Trendlyne data, both of whose numeric channels were unavailable this pass.

name: United Drilling Tools Ltd
moat_evidence: Working in a niche segment: holds API monogram licences 5CT, 5L, 5B, 7-1, 7-2, 19G1 and 19G2, plus ISO 13679:2019, covering oilfield casing, drill pipe and gas-lift equipment — UDT certifications page (udtltd.com/oilfield-equipment-manufacturers/our-certifications-and-licenses/)

Working in a niche segment: "UNITED DRILLING TOOLS LTD is one of the world's leading manufacturers of high quality products used in the upstream operations" — UDT About page (udtltd.com/oilfield-equipment-manufacturers/about-udt/)
research_note: United Drilling Tools Ltd (UNIDT, BSE 522014) is classed by Trendlyne under General Industrials / Other Industrial Goods, matching the 'precision engineering' hint; Screener puts market cap at about Rs 436 crore with ROCE 10.4%, and describes large-OD multi-start casing connectors, casing pipes, wireline winches and artificial gas-lift downhole tools sold into oil and gas drilling, with premium casing pipes recently commissioned in an Oil India gas well. The stack of API monogram licences and ISO 13679 is specific, verifiable and a genuine qualification barrier in a small field, which carries the niche-segment criterion. Flagged unclear because no India market-share figure or ranking exists in any source reached: the 'India's largest manufacturer' phrasing appears only in search-engine summaries, while UDT's own pages claim just 'one of the world's leading', and ROCE of 10.4% does not suggest much pricing power.

name: Mangalam Organics Ltd
moat_evidence: India's leading manufacturer: Screener.in's company page describes Mangalam Organics as "the world's largest manufacturer of Camphor" (screener.in/company/MANORG, read 31-Aug-2026)

Working in a niche segment: pine/terpene chemistry portfolio — camphor, camphene, isobornyl acetate, isoborneol, dipentene, terpineol and sodium acetate, plus terpene-phenolic, alkyl-phenolic and rosin-based resins (mangalamorganics.com product pages)
research_note: Mangalam Organics Ltd (MANORG, BSE 514418) is classed by Trendlyne under Chemicals & Petrochemicals / Commodity Chemicals; Screener puts market cap at about Rs 439 crore on TTM sales of Rs 655 crore, with ROCE 10.5% and ROE 9.3%. Screener's own company page states it is the world's largest manufacturer of camphor, and the company site confirms a pine-chemicals and terpene-resin portfolio — a sourced hit on the leading-manufacturer and niche-segment criteria. Flagged unclear rather than promising because the leadership claim is not matched by pricing power in Screener's numbers: operating margin has swung from 38% (FY21) to -0.6% (FY23) to 14% (FY26) while borrowings rose from Rs 20 crore to Rs 359 crore, which reads as commodity price pass-through. No India-specific market-share percentage was found; Trendlyne's document and overview channels were rate-limited for this entire pass.

name: Shish Industries Ltd
moat_evidence: India's leading manufacturer / working in a niche segment: "It was the first to develop and patent 5-ply Polypropylene Corrugated Sheets, created the reflective insulation product called Carmika, and pioneered insulated water tank covers in India" — Screener.in Key Points (screener.in/company/540693)
research_note: Shish Industries Ltd (SHISHIND, BSE 540693) is classed by Trendlyne under General Industrials / Plastic Products; Screener puts market cap at about Rs 444 crore and records 42% ten-year and 34% five-year sales CAGR. It manufactures, trades and markets PP sheets and rolls for protective packaging. Screener's key points carry a first-in-India-and-patented claim for 5-ply polypropylene corrugated sheets, along with the Carmika reflective insulation product and insulated water tank covers — a sourced hit on the leading-manufacturer and niche criteria. Flagged unclear because it rests on a single company-supplied claim with no market-share figure behind it, PP sheet extrusion is otherwise a competitive product, and the share trades at Rs 10.5: the evidence is real but thin.

research_note: Simplex Castings Ltd (SIMPLEXCAS, BSE 513472) is classed by Trendlyne under General Industrials / Other Industrial Products, matching the 'precision engineering' hint; Screener puts market cap at about Rs 447 crore with ROCE 24.3% and ROE 25.7%. The Bhilai company makes heavy engineering castings in grey and alloy cast iron and stainless steel, and in May 2026 announced RDSO approval to prototype-test cast steel CASNUB bogies, side frames, bolsters and centre pivot assemblies — a regulator-gated railway product where the approved supplier list is short, which fits the niche criterion. Flagged unclear because the approval is at prototype-testing stage, the 60-70% share figure is explicitly historical rather than current, and the Rs 50-100 crore revenue attached to it is management's own projection.
